name: Higashinaruse (Japan)
description: A blue field charged at the centre with the Higashinaruse village emblem in white: a stylised swirl like a letter G with the characters 成瀬.
history: Municipal flag of Higashinaruse, a village in Akita Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted on 25 May 1967.

features.role: Higashinaruse village emblem — a stylised swirl like a letter G with the characters 成瀬
